corrected_code:
class CameraSerializer < ActiveModel::Serializer
  attributes :id, :name, :streaming_url

  has_many :cloud_recordings

  def cloud_recordings
    if scope&.camera_owner?(object)
      object.cloud_recordings
    elsif (grant = scope&.access_grants&.find_by(camera: object))
      object.cloud_recordings.where('created_at >= ?', grant.valid_from)
    else
      CloudRecording.none
    end
  end
end

class Api::CamerasController < ApplicationController
  def show
    camera = Camera.find(params[:id])
    render json: camera
  end
end
